queries.query: Ilebo Democratic Republic of the Congo official cadastral land registry parcel map cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery located the official Ministry of Land Affairs website and its public land-research service. The results document the national cadastre/land registry custodian and a request procedure, but no anonymous Ilebo parcel map or downloadable parcel vector layer.

queries.query: Ilebo RDC cadastre parcelles carte foncière officiel
queries.result: La recherche en français a confirmé le Ministère des Affaires Foncières comme custodian national et a trouvé la procédure officielle de recherche foncière. Aucun visualiseur public de parcelles d'Ilebo ni service anonyme de géométrie n'a été identifié.

registryCustodian: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la République démocratique du Congo; local custodians are the relevant Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers and Chef de Division du Cadastre, but an Ilebo-specific office/layer was not verified.

registryEvidence.evidence: The Ministry site describes land affairs and cadastre services. The official request form asks for province, land registry district, commune/territory and parcel/reference fields. The public-service catalogue describes consultation of cadastral and real-estate registers through the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre.

sourceReview.service: Official RDC Ministry of Land Affairs public website and land-research request workflow
sourceReview.configurationFindings: Current page JavaScript was inspected. The form submits multipart data to /api/demandes-foncieres. No public parcel-map, WMS, WFS, GeoJSON, vector-tile, or anonymous ID+geometry route was exposed in the inspected page assets.
